description: This file defines the code-behind logic for the SetExam page in an online examination system. It includes event handlers for page load, button clicks, dropdown selections, and database interactions to manage questions and exams for different courses and semesters.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the SetExam ASP.NET page, handling question and exam management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently commented out.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears all question and tag input fields.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new multiple-choice question into the database and updates question number display.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam record for the selected course.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the question count for the selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and transfers to the login page.
